chapter.verse: Khris Jesu' adinga thongkia keimah Paul leh i sanggampih Timothy in kong it uh naseppih Philemon na hi zongin,
i sanggamnu Apphia, i galdopih Archippus, leh nang' inn-a om pawlpi ahi zongin, kong hopih uh hi.
Note' tungah hehpihna hong tung henla i Pa Pasian leh Topa Jesu Khris' kiangpan nopna lemna hong om ta hen.
Ka thungetna ah nang hong phawkin ka Pasian' tungah lungdam ka ko den hi.
A hang pen Topa Jesu leh mi siangtho khempeuh' tunga na neih itna leh upna thu ka na za hi.
Upna sungah nong kikholhkhop pen Khris' hanga eite' sunga om a hoih thute khempeuh theihna cingtaak a piangsak ahih nading, thu ka ngen hi.
A hang pen ka sanggampa aw, nang' tungtawnin mi siangthote a lungsim uh tawldam thaksuak ahih manin nangma' itna hangin lungdamna leh noptuamna tampi ka ngah hi.
Tua tawh kizui-in a kilawm thu na sep nadingin Khris sungah thu hong pia ngam mahmah ka hih hangin
itna thu hang mahin kong thum ding utzaw ka hih manin-khangham khat leh Khris Jesu' adingin thongkia khat ahi keimah Paul in-
ka tapa Onesimus' adingin nang kong thum hi. Ka thongkiat sungin ama' pa a suak ka hi hi.
(Amah pen nidangin nang' ading a kimanna om lo a, ahi zongin tu-in ahihleh nang leh kei' ading kimanna a nei ahi hi.)
Ka lungtang laikuai ahi amah nang' kiangah kong puakkik hi.
Lungdamna Thu tangkona hangin thongkia-in ka om sung nang' tangin kei hong don dingin amah ka kiangah ka omsuaksak nuam hi.
Himah taleh hihloh phatmawh man ahilo, uttawm thu tawh nahoih a sem na hih nading ahi hi.
Banghanghiam cihleh amah tawlkhat sung nang' kiangpan a gamla a va tun pen amah a ngahkik paisuak na hih nading zong hikha thei ding hi.

Tua hi a, sila khat bang hi nawnlo, sila sangin a sangzaw, sanggam it khat bangin na san ding ahi hi. Kei' adingin ka sanggam it hi takpi a, nang' adingin zong cilesa lamah hitaleh Topa' sungah hitaleh na it hizaw kan lai hi.
Tua ahih manin nangma' kithuahpih khatin nong sim leh kei nong san ding bang mahin amah na sang in.
Nang' tungah hong khialh ngeileh, ahihkeileh zong leiba hong neih leh, kei' kong batin na ciaptehsak in.
Keimah Paul in keima' khut mahmah tawh kong gelhin ah: Tua kong lohkik ding hi. Na nuntakna mahmah kei' tunga nong bat ahihlam genna vet om lo hi.
Himah hi, sanggampa aw, Topa' sungah hong hamphasak dih in. Khris sungah ka sungtha hong tawldamsak dih in.
A thumang na hihna lungmuangin leh kong gen zah sangin zong sem ding na hihlam thei ka hih manin lai hong gelh ka hi hi.
Tua kawm mahin zintunna inndei khat a baihsa-in na koih in. A hang pen nong thungetsaknate uh tungtawnin note' kiangah hunnuam ngah thei dingin ka kilamen hi.
Khris Jesu sungah ka thongkiatpih Epaphras in note hong hopih hi.
Ka naseppih Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, leh Luke -te in zong hong hopih uh hi.
Topa Jesu Khris' hehpihna in na kha uh hong ompih ta hen.
